headline: CHC @ MIL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CHC 3.47 at MIL 5.11, with a projected total of 8.59. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIL: CHC moved -0.62 runs while MIL moved +0.44, changing the projected margin by -1.06 runs. NRFI probability rose +8.9%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Jacob Misiorowski has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Pete Crow-Armstrong, Brice Turang, Seiya Suzuki, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags David Hamilton because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
